verdict.rationale: Stripe publishes an official OpenAPI specification repository (stripe/openapi) explicitly described as containing files 'to generate SDKs or client libraries that support Stripe's API,' confirming a downloadable, machine-readable spec exists, and this is corroborated by the llms.txt/docs.md machine-readable documentation surface. Missing for 10: a stable, discoverable link from the main docs.stripe.com site itself (probe shows openapi.json/swagger.json 404 at expected doc paths) and independent hands-on confirmation of spec completeness/versioning cadence.
